items.title: What Should Investors Make Of Kroger (KR) Cutting 3,000 Jobs And Expanding In India?
items.summary: Kroger (NYSE:KR) announced plans to cut about 3,000 US corporate roles while expanding operations in India. Management framed the US reductions and Indian expansion as part of a broader push toward more technology-led operations.
